dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: It is truly magnificent. Completely different from my homeland, Fontaine!

dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: I passed by Qingyun Peak on my way here. Its profile was almost completely obscured by the heavy fog, and it really was a sight to behold.

dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: This scenery really makes one want to compose a verse or two, just like the poets of Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: Look upon the mountains, magnificent as the... Wait, what should I compare them to?

dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: Never mind. This mountain is just magnificent!
